meta.title: SogaeBank
meta.description: A P2P referral platform where anyone — individuals or businesses — can refer clients, listings and business spots and earn referral fees

footer.tipCompany: Company name — to be entered before launch
footer.tipCeo: CEO — to be entered before launch

home.artnoteSample: Photos, rankings, ratings and people on the home page are design samples — not real listings, products or reviews. Vote counts in “What do you think?” are real.
home.artnoteLive: Images on the home page illustrate categories — they are not photos of real listings or products.
home.demoSub: A rules engine — no AI model API is called.

classify.s: Sorts posts into section, category and grade

match.s: Change the weights and the ranking changes

profile.s: Ads and recommendations are picked from this

prompt.s: Reads a sentence and picks candidates

login.title: Log in
login.lead: Individuals can join too and post requests or take part in referrals. Verify your identity and you can also receive referral fees. Individuals can do everything; only fields that require a license (real estate, insurance, medical, etc.) need that license before posting.
login.reconsentLb: If the terms changed since your last login
login.reconsentBody: you go to the terms consent page right after logging in — review the changes, agree to the required terms, and you continue where you were going.
login.pendingLb: If your account is awaiting approval
login.pendingBody: you can still log in. If you have verified your identity, posting, creating deals and settlement work right away — business approval only matters when you receive fees as a business (tax invoice). We show any remaining steps when you need them. Browsing and search are unrestricted.
login.profileSub: Six questions after you sign up or log in
login.profileBody: Home-page ads and referral suggestions follow your interests. We never give it to advertisers, and you can delete it anytime.
login.whoCanJoin: Individuals, sole proprietors and corporations can all join. Suspended or closed businesses cannot pass business verification.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.lead: Enter your sign-up email and we will send a password reset link. The link works once, for 30 minutes.
forgot.noMailBody: Check your spam folder first. If you cannot remember your email, contact the help center under “Account” — we will help after confirming it is you.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.lead: Enter a new password — at least 10 characters mixing letters, numbers and symbols. Changing it signs you out on all other devices.
reset.badBody: Make sure you opened the link exactly as it is in the email. If 30 minutes have passed or you already used it, please request a new one.

loginForm.needBoth: Please enter your email and password.
loginForm.emailPh: The email you signed up with

pwForm.weak: Your password must be at least 10 characters and mix letters, numbers and symbols.
pwForm.emailInvalid: That email address does not look right.
pwForm.sentDefault: If that email is registered, we sent a reset link.
pwForm.emailPh: The email you signed up with
pwForm.devLink: Development test link (in production it is sent by email only):
pwForm.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.lead: Individuals can sign up too. Individuals can post requests and take part in referrals, and receive referral fees after identity verification. Once verified you can do everything; only fields that require a license (real estate, insurance, medical, etc.) need that license before posting.

PERSONAL.label: Individual
PERSONAL.sub: Post requests and take part in referrals.

SOLE.label: Sole proprietor
SOLE.sub: Verified with your business registration number.

CORP.label: Corporation
CORP.sub: Needs your business and corporate registration numbers.

err.brn10: Please enter your 10-digit business registration number.
err.lookupFail: The lookup failed. Please try again shortly.
err.verifyFirst: Verify your business registration number to continue.
err.taken: This business number is already registered — one account per business.
err.closed: Suspended or closed businesses cannot sign up.
err.corp13: Please enter your 13-digit corporate registration number.
err.name: Please enter your real name.
err.soleSelf: For a sole proprietorship, the CEO must be you — your name and the CEO name must match.
err.weakPw: Your password must be at least 10 characters and mix letters, numbers and symbols.
err.pwMismatch: The password confirmation does not match.
err.requiredTerms: Agree to all required items to continue.

signup.typeSameLb: Individuals and businesses can do the same things
signup.typeSameBody: Individuals can post requests and take part in referrals, and receive referral fees after identity verification. Only fields that require a license (real estate, insurance, medical, etc.) need that license before posting. To receive fees as a business (tax invoice), switch to a business account later in My page.

typeText.PERSONAL: Start right away without a business registration. You can post requests and take part in referrals, and receive referral fees after identity verification. You can do everything; only fields that require a license (real estate, insurance, medical, etc.) need that license before posting.
typeText.SOLE: We verify your 10-digit business registration number. The CEO must be you. We also check that the business is not suspended or closed.
typeText.CORP: We verify both your business registration number and your 13-digit corporate registration number. The CEO may be someone other than you.

biz.title: 2. Business check
biz.brnHint: Corporations and sole proprietors alike go through the National Tax Service status check. Suspended or closed businesses cannot sign up.
biz.corpHint: Checked against corporate registry records. Sole proprietors do not have this.
biz.corpNoneHint: Sole proprietors do not need a corporate registration number.
biz.okStub: — this is a simulated result until the tax service is connected.
biz.okNote: The tax status check does not return the company or CEO name — enter them exactly as on your registration certificate. Our staff check them at approval.
biz.taken: This business number is already registered — one account per business.
biz.closedLine: The tax service shows this business as {state}{detail}.
biz.beforeBody: Verify your business registration number to continue. Verify checks the tax status and whether the number is already registered.
biz.fail1: the business is suspended or closed — caught by the tax lookup regardless of type
biz.fail2: the business number is already registered — one account per business
biz.fail3: the company name differs from the tax-registered name
biz.soleSelf: For a sole proprietorship the CEO must be you (same as your name in step 3).

person.title: 3. Your details
person.diffLb: How this differs from the business check
person.diffBody: The business check confirms the business; identity verification confirms the person. Use your real name — it is matched with the bank account holder at settlement.
person.name: Your name
person.phoneBody: After signing up you go straight to identity verification (PASS). The verified name must match your settlement account holder.
person.emailHint: Review results and settlement notices go to this address. It is also your login ID.
person.pwWeak: At least 10 characters mixing letters, numbers and symbols
person.pw2Diff: Does not match the password above

terms.title: 4. Terms
terms.noneBody: No terms have been published yet — we will ask for consent once they are.
terms.allSub: I agree to all required and optional items.
terms.afterBiz: Business verification completes after staff approval, usually within 1 business day. Even before approval, with identity verification you can do everything, including posting and creating deals — after approval you receive fees as a business (tax invoice).
terms.afterPersonal: Individuals join immediately. To receive referral fees, verify your identity after signing up.
terms.fullBody: “View ›” opens the full terms in a new window. Agree to all required items to continue.
terms.noticeTail: — these are notices about who we entrust data to and for what, not items to agree to (nothing to choose).

profile.title: 5. Interests
profile.whyBody: Used only to choose home-page ads and the order of referral suggestions. Never given to advertisers; you can delete it later in My page.
profile.consent: By signing up I agree that this is saved and used to sort home-page ads and suggestions (never given to advertisers · delete anytime).
profile.noneBody: You can skip this. In that case only general ads are shown.
